title: Near Inclusions of von Neumann Algebras Without Small Spatial Embeddings

abstractEnglish: We give a negative answer to the unrestricted small-spatial-embedding problem for one-sided near inclusions of von Neumann algebras. On separable complex Hilbert spaces, we construct pairs of unital von Neumann algebras with common identity whose one-sided gaps tend to zero. Spatial embeddings of the source into the target exist, but every implementing unitary stays a fixed positive distance from the identity. The obstruction therefore concerns small implementing unitaries, rather than the existence of spatial embeddings.

titleZh: 无小空间嵌入的von Neumann代数近包含

details.overview: 稿件对von Neumann代数单侧近包含的无限制小空间嵌入问题给出否定回答。在可分复Hilbert空间上，作者构造具有公共单位元的单位von Neumann代数对，其单侧间隙趋于零；源到靶的空间嵌入存在，但每个实现酉元都与单位元保持固定正距离。摘要表示障碍在于小的实现酉元，而非空间嵌入的存在性。
